scripts.start: npm run frontend:build && npm run backend:start
scripts.backend:start: cd backend && venv\Scripts\python manage.py collectstatic --noinput && venv\Scripts\daphne -p 8000 config.asgi:application
scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt && venv\Scripts\python manage.py migrate
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
